description: Finds places in Tbilisi (addresses, streets, buildings) by text, with their coordinates, for transit_plan_trip and transit_list_nearby_stops. Data from OpenStreetMap through the TTC.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of places, 1 to 20. The default is 5.

query.description: An address, a street, or a building in Tbilisi.

name: transit_search_places

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the places, RFC 3339.

places.description: The matching places, in the order of the TTC.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC, from OpenStreetMap.

stale.description: True when the TTC did not answer and the server returns places it read before.

title: Search places in Tbilisi
